# obot_mcp_access_rule (Data Source)

Reads one catalog MCP access policy by exact ID, preserving its actual subjects and resources for inspection. This lookup never creates or updates a policy and does not read vMCP profiles.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "obot_mcp_access_rule" "everything" {
  id = "acr1-everything"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The exact rule identifier, for example `acr1-everything`. A missing rule is an error.

### Read-Only

- `catalog_id` (String) The catalog containing this policy, always `default`.
- `display_name` (String) The policy's display name; names need not be unique.
- `generated` (Boolean) Whether Obot generated this rule. Generated rules cannot be managed by the Terraform resource.
- `resources` (Attributes Set) Actual resources covered by this policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))
- `subjects` (Attributes Set) Actual subjects receiving this grant. Inspect these before importing; Everything is a name, not an everyone selector. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subjects))

<a id="nestedatt--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The referenced ID or wildcard `*`.
- `type` (String) The reference type.


<a id="nestedatt--subjects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subjects`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The referenced ID or wildcard `*`.
- `type` (String) The reference type.
